item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:50 HKT 11/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. It will be warm during the day. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas in the latter part of this week. There will be a few rain patches over the region. The easterly airstream will be gradually replaced by a relatively dry continental airstream over the weekend. The weather will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the seas east of the Philippines will move towards the vicinity of Luzon in the next couple of days and then weaken gradually.
